mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES continues to edge up from its recent trough, weekday trips and lunch-time retail visits will recover, pushing RETAIL_REC above its last-four-week mean within four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week mean for the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES rising week over week.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT remains depressed, people cluster at home and substitute away from discretionary shopping trips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above 7 and TRANSIT below -30 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 4-week mean after the residential-high/transit-low condition holds for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A further deterioration in PARKS below zero signals weak outdoor leisure demand and poor discretionary outing intensity, which will spill into lower retail-and-recreation mobility over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken within 7 days after PARKS moves from positive to negative territory.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, simultaneous weakness in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES suppresses destination-based shopping and errands, so RETAIL_REC will decline over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:Greater London snapshot shows both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are still far below baseline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat for 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain materially below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM continues to soften while RETAIL_REC is already weak, households are consolidating trips into essential purchasing and cutting incidental shopping, which will keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -4 after being above -4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM drops below -4.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in PARKS together with stable RESIDENTIAL implies colder or wetter outdoor conditions, which shifts leisure time indoors and reduces retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform its last 28-day average while PARKS stays negative and RESIDENTIAL remains elevated.

mechanism_narrative: Once TRANSIT stops improving and remains below its recent level, access friction to shopping districts persists and RETAIL_REC will be lower than the previous four-week mean within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -30 for at least two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days after TRANSIT stays below -30 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps rising while RESIDENTIAL holds flat, commuting intensity returns without a matching home-stay offset, which should lift discretionary retail visits and raise RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weeks and RESIDENTIAL does not increase
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 7 days after WORKPLACES rises for two weeks without a concurrent RESIDENTIAL increase.
